en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a public square in Bruges, Belgium. The foreground shows people in early 20th-century attire walking and socializing. On the left, there is a building with a sign reading 'MERCERIES'. In the background, a prominent medieval tower (the Belfry of Bruges) is visible. On the right, there is a grand, ornate building, labeled as the 'Hôtel du Gouvernement'. The postcard is captioned in French at the bottom.
